newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Capital One cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Capital One cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Furman Selz said it downgraded Capital One Financial Corp to neutral from buy and removed the stock from the recommended list.
-- Trimmed 1997 earnings estimate to $2.50 a share from $2.75 a share and cut 1998 estimate to $3.05 a share from $3.30 a share.

-- Cited Capital's disclosure that its customers are paying down debt and reducing their spending more than anticipated, creating lower past-due and over-the-limit fees, as well as slower volume growth.
-- Capital One said it expects its second quarter earnings to be flat compared to last year's second quarter earnings of $0.57 a share.
-- On a consensus basis, analysts had expected Capital One to post second quarter earnings of $0.66 a share, according to First Call.
